metadata.description: MCP connectors for Claude: PUC Minas Canvas, multi-account Gmail and Spotify (bring your own app).

plugins.name: canvas-puc
plugins.description: PUC Minas Canvas LMS in the cloud: due dates, assignments, grades, announcements, modules, files, discussions and inbox messages. Nothing is installed on your computer.

plugins.name: gmail
plugins.description: Multi-account Gmail in the cloud: read, search, send, reply, forward, drafts, labels, archive and trash, with confirmation before sending or deleting. Nothing is installed on your computer.

plugins.name: spotify
plugins.description: Spotify in the cloud with your own Spotify app: search, Liked Songs, playlists (read, create, edit, sort, split, merge), follows, history, top items and playback, plus bulk cleanups with preview, automatic backups and restore. Nothing is installed on your computer.
